content: Supaiga Jesusta juchayachisha nishcamanda
Jesus bautisarishcahuasha Diospa Samaiga chaquishca partima paita apara supai paita camachun nisha.
Chuscu chunga (40) tuta punzhandi sasisha mana imatas micusha Jesus raicaihuan aura.
Chasna aushcai supai pai juchata rachun nisha camangahua shamura, Can Diospa churi ashaga cai rumigunata panda rai nira.
Randi Jesus paita cutipara, Diospa shimi casnami nin: Runa mana micunahuanllachu causan, astahuanbas Yaya Dios tucui rimashcata uyashami causana man nin.
Chasna rimacpi supai Jesusta Jerusalen llactama apasha Diosta alabana huasi jahuaibi shayachira.

Chihuasha nira, Diospa shimibiga casna nisha quillcashcami tiyan: Diosca paihua angelgunata cachangami canda cuirangahua nisha. Paiguna maquihuan japisha canda marcanaunga can ima rumigunaibis tacarichun nisha nin. Chasna acpi can Diospa churi ashaga caimanda saltai nira.
Chasna nicpi Jesus randi nira, Diospa shimi chasnallata nin: Canda mandac Diosta ama can munashcata mandasha camanguichu ninmi nira.
Cutillata supai shuc jahua urcuma Jesusta apara. Chibi apasha ricuchira tucui cai pachai tiyac llactagunatas, chibi tiyac gustugunatahuas.
Ricuchishcahuasha supai nira, Cai tucuita cushcanguimi can ñucahuacpi cungurisha alabahuacpiga.

Chasna rimacpi Jesus paita cutipara, Ñáucamanda anchurisha ri supai. Diospa shimibi quillcashca ninmi: Canda mandac Diosta alabana angui, paillata cadsusha causana mangui, casnami Diospa shimiga nin nira.
Chita uyasha supai Jesusta saquisha rira. Chihuashalla Diospa angelguna shamusha Jesusta caranaura.
Jesus yachachisha callarishcamanda
Shuc punzha mandac Herodes bautisac Juanda carcelbi tapara. Jesus chita uyasha Judea provinciamanda llucshisha Galilea provinciama rira.
Nazaret llactamanda llucshisha Capernaun nishca llactama rira chibi angahua. Capernaun llactaga jatun cucha pataibi tiyara, Zabulón Neptalí nishca provinciagunaibi.
Chasna racpi Dios rimashcata pasachic ñaupa causauc Isaias nishca runa rimashcacuinta tucura casna nisha:

content.text: Galilea cucha mayanbi, lamarma rina ñambibi aun.

content: Chi urasmanda Jesus camachingahua callarira casna nisha, Diospa ali mandanaga ña pactarimunmi paihua runagunata japingarausha. Chasna acpi canguna causaita cambiarichi, nira.
Jesushuan punda catic runagunamanda

Shuc punzha Jesus Galilea cucha patata puriushcai tupara ishcai (2) huauquipurata. Shuca Pedro nishca Simon ara, shuca Andres ara, ishcandimi yacu aichata japiccuna anaura. Jesus pasaushcaibi paiguna licasha shayaunaura.

Chi runagunata ricusha Jesus rimara, Ñáucata catihuaichi. Canguna imasna yacu aichata japishcanguichi chicuintallata cunanmanda ñaupagma runagunata japicshina tucunguichi ñucamanda yachachisha. Chasna cangunata rashami.
Jesus chasna rimashca ratullai paiguna licagunata saquisha paihuan rinaura.

Chinicshinai mas ishcai runagunata tupara, paigunas huauquipurami anaura Zebedeoba churiguna, shuca Santiago, shuca Juan ara. Paihua yayahuan canuaibi licagunata alichiunaura. Paigunatas Jesus nira, Ñáucata catihuaichi.
Chi ratullai paiguna yayata canuatas saquisha Jesusta catisha rinaura.
Jesus ungushcagunata alichishcamanda

Jesus Galilea llactagunaibi puriusha israelguna tandarina huasigunai yaicusha yachachira Diospa ali mandanamanda cuintasha, paimi quishpichinata munan nisha rimasha ali shimita yachachira. Chasnallata caran tunu ungushcagunata tucuita alichira.

Tucui Siria nishca partigunaibi Jesusmanda rimashcata uyarira. Chasna acpi caran tunu ungushca runagunatas, sinzhi nanaihuan turmintarisha causaccunatahuas apamunaura pai janbichun nisha. Chasnallata supai yaicushca runagunatas, ataquiyuc tucusha causaccunatahuas, suchu runagunatas paihuagma apamunaura. Chi tucui chasna ungushcagunataga alichira.
Ashca runagunami paita catinaura Galilea provinciamanda, Decapolis nishca llactagunamandas, Jerusalenmandas, Judea provinciamandas, Jordan yacu chimbamanda accunahuas paita catinaura.
